description: Phase 5 (post-test-fixup) — at-break visibility gate. Clip A on track 0 ends at the section break (frame 60), clip B on track 1 starts at the section break. fadeSeconds=0 so neither clip has an authored fade envelope. While SectionScheduler holds the playhead at the break, clip B (which starts at the break) must be suppressed by the new gate (multiplier 0.0) -- otherwise its first frame would pop on screen during the at-break pause. Clip A is at currentFrame == clipEnd, the held-tail boundary (multiplier 1.0). After SectionGo the gate releases and clip B becomes fully visible (multiplier 1.0) since fadeSeconds=0.
